## Current

- Software Engineer Intern, Intelligent Creation (Effect House) at TikTok, San Jose, CA (May-Sep 2026).
  Built an overnight agent-evaluation flywheel, a runtime verifier, and an MCP performance
  agent for creators on the TikTok Effect House desktop codebase.
- M.S. Computer Science, Northeastern University (expected May 2027). 4.0 CGPA.
  Coursework: Information Retrieval, Building Distributed Systems, OS Kernel Implementation,
  Agentic AI, Programming Language Principles, Database Management Systems, Network Programming.
- B.Eng. Electronic Engineering, HKUST (2020-2024), Second Class Honours Division I.

## Focus areas

- Agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP (Model Context
  Protocol) servers, agent routing and scheduling, agent-callable automation.
- LLM infrastructure: multi-provider gateways (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Llama 3 via Ollama),
  on-prem model serving, streaming responses, token accounting, compliance-constrained deployment.
- Retrieval: RAG pipelines, document ingestion and chunking, embeddings and vector search,
  context assembly and budgeting.
- Evaluation: graded eval harnesses, held-out oracles, grading rubrics, instrumentation audits,
  regression tracking across runs.
- Distributed systems: TTL leases and state ownership, lock taxonomies, atomic state publication,
  failure isolation, idempotent crash recovery, state-machine control.
- Graphics and interactive systems: Effect House AR tooling, Babylon.js, WebGL, WebXR,
  Meta Quest 3, OpenGL render pipelines, Blender asset pipelines.
